title: Green Tree Tavern (Janis-Ziegler House)
scope: The extant Nicolas Janis House, now Green Tree Tavern, with its French Colonial porch galleries, limestone foundation, flared roof, chimneys and street retaining wall.
limitations: The site bearing is taken from the north-oriented measured site plan. Historic millwork, weathering and the stone grade break are simplified to the available photographic and survey detail.
